The wastewater is treated by a 1,250-gallon septic tank that provides anaerobic primary treatment and settling, a septic tank effluent filter, and a 200-square foot intermittent sand filter system...

The wastewater is treated by ... a 200-square foot intermittent sand filter system, including a 750-gallon pump/dosing tank and a supplemental air injection system, which provides aerobic secondary treatment.
Effluent is then disinfected by ultraviolet (UV) light treatment prior to discharge to San Pablo Bay.
